title: Clicking on an empty area of the Panel takes away focus from Desktop items, but you can't do anything with focus on the panel
line: Clicking an empty part of the panel no longer takes keyboard focus away from the selected desktop icon, so Enter still opens it.
explanation: The panel never takes keyboard focus, but since the fix for bug 367815 it posts a fake focus-out event to the focused Plasma window when an empty part of it is clicked, so open applet popups close. The check matched any frameless window, including the desktop itself, so Folder View lost its active focus while the desktop window kept the real keyboard focus: Enter went nowhere and nothing showed it. The change skips the desktop view, so only popups and other Plasma windows still get the fake focus out.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: don't take focus from the desktop when clicked

Clicking an empty area of a panel sent a fake focus out event to every
frameless Plasma window, including the desktop, so a selected desktop
icon lost keyboard focus to nothing. Leave the desktop view alone.

BUG: 502225

patches.diff:
From d0ecbf34d917f8356b36de81f6764add657a09ff Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:04:57 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] shell/panelview: don't take focus from the desktop when
 clicked

Clicking an empty area of a panel sent a fake focus out event to every
frameless Plasma window, including the desktop, so a selected desktop
icon lost keyboard focus to nothing. Leave the desktop view alone.

BUG: 502225
---
 shell/panelview.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/shell/panelview.cpp b/shell/panelview.cpp
index 5c0ac43e71..61c20c5b67 100644
--- a/shell/panelview.cpp
+++ b/shell/panelview.cpp
@@ -1314,7 +1314,7 @@ bool PanelView::event(QEvent *e)
         auto *me = static_cast<QMouseEvent *>(e);
         if (!me->allPointsGrabbed()) {
             QWindow *focusWindow = qGuiApp->focusWindow();
-            if (focusWindow && focusWindow != this && focusWindow->flags().testFlag(Qt::FramelessWindowHint)) {
+            if (focusWindow && focusWindow != this && !qobject_cast<DesktopView *>(focusWindow) && focusWindow->flags().testFlag(Qt::FramelessWindowHint)) {
                 // postEvent takes ownership of the event
                 auto *fe = new QFocusEvent(QEvent::FocusOut);
                 qGuiApp->postEvent(focusWindow, fe);
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Select the desktop folder, click an empty spot of the Task Manager, press Enter: nothing opens
Same steps with the fix: Enter opens the folder in Dolphin
Result 5 s after Enter: no window
Result 5 s after Enter: the folder is open in Dolphin

review.text: Accurately targets the real cause in PanelView::event(): because PanelView never takes keyboard focus, its synthetic FocusOut for frameless Plasma windows (meant for popups) was stripping Qt Quick active focus from DesktopView while leaving KWin focus on the desktop, sending Enter into a void. Excluding DesktopView via qobject_cast makes clicking empty panel areas behave consistently with regular app windows while keeping popup dismissal and Meta+Alt+P panel focus intact. Verification cleanly confirms the fix and checks keyboard panel navigation.

reviews.text: Accurately targets the real cause in PanelView::event(): because PanelView never takes keyboard focus, its synthetic FocusOut for frameless Plasma windows (meant for popups) was stripping Qt Quick active focus from DesktopView while leaving KWin focus on the desktop, sending Enter into a void. Excluding DesktopView via qobject_cast makes clicking empty panel areas behave consistently with regular app windows while keeping popup dismissal and Meta+Alt+P panel focus intact. Verification cleanly confirms the fix and checks keyboard panel navigation.

Accurate root cause: since the fix for 367815 PanelView posts a fake FocusOut to the focused frameless Plasma window on an empty-area click so that applet popups close, and that also hit the DesktopView, leaving Folder View without active focus while the desktop kept the real keyboard focus. Excluding DesktopView is a minimal, targeted change in the right place: popups are separate windows and still get the fake focus-out, so 367815's purpose is kept, and DesktopView is already included in panelview.cpp. The before/after recordings and the 5 s result screenshots show Enter doing nothing on master and opening the folder with the fix, and Meta+Alt+P panel navigation was checked; the side effect (an in-progress desktop rename no longer ends on an empty panel click) is consistent with the panel never really taking focus. Nate's arrow-key desktop/panel navigation idea in c2 is a separate wish, not part of this report.
